description: Get computed market metrics for a company: volume averages, volatility, simple moving averages, RSI(14) on split-adjusted daily closes (rsi14, with the session it is as of in rsi14AsOf; null = not measured) and trend direction, beyond the basic quote.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

name: get_market_metrics
title: Get Market Metrics
